title: TimberEdge
description: One-log tree feller with safety caps and axe control.
body:
# TimberEdge

Overview
TimberEdge breaks connected logs when you chop one, with strict safety limits for clean survival play.

Highlights
- One log to fell the whole tree.
- Max block cap prevents runaway chain breaks.
- Optional leaves breaking and axe-only requirement.
- Per-player toggle with /timberedge on|off.

Commands
- /timberedge [status|on|off|reload]

Permissions
- timberedge.use

Config
- require-axe, max-blocks, include-leaves

Tags
timber, tree-feller, logging, axe, wood, survival, qol

Compatibility
Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
Game versions: 1.16.5 - 1.21.1
